name: bittersweet
quote: Romeo and Juliet is a tragic love story.
description: An experience or memory that provokes both positive and negative sensations at the same time.
perceptions: Something has happened (or is remembered) that provokes roughly equal amounts of positive and negative sensations.

variations.name: poignant
variations.description: A strong emotional responses where a deep positive sensation is mixed with sadness.
perceptions: Something has happened (or is remembered) that provokes deep positive sensations as well as sadness.
examples: A surprise ending to a book that's deep but sad.

comparisons.description: 'Poignant' is a specific form of 'bittersweet' where the negative sensation is sadness, but it's balanced by an emotional depth.
Dissonance is any kind of scenario where multiple sensations are firing. Bittersweet is a special case of dissonance where the sensations are roughly equal parts positive and negative.

commentaries.quote: Leaving the space station was bittersweet - I had been there for a long time and looked forward to leaving, but it is a remarkable place.

If you go back to your home town or you're reunited with school friends, its always slightly bittersweet because as much as there's nice things in terms of seeing them again, the town has changed without you, and you're no longer a part of it.

As a pastor, you get invited into the most poignant moments of people's lives. Whether it's a wedding or a funeral or a hospital visit, you get invited into the center of the event, whether or not you know the people.
I think one of the most poignant things is unrequited love and loneliness.
